issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement declares the class as 'Course' while the rest of the problem text, the template, and the solution consistently use the class name 'Lecture'. This naming mismatch between the UML and the described/template code can confuse students about the expected class name and which file to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML diagram in problem_statement.md to use the class name 'Lecture' (and keep the attribute order as specified). Ensure the diagram labels and any references to the class match 'Lecture' so students are not confused about which class to implement.
